Jagdish Prasad Bansal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 4 September, 2025
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14655402/
1

 Hon'Ble Jitendra Kumar Sinha, J. 
1.
The case ks taken up on mentioning.
2. Supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.

3. Heard Shri Ashish Goyal, learned counsel for the applicant and Shri Chandra Shekhar Singh,
learned AGA for the State.
4.

This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been preferred for quashing of the entire proceedings,
including proceedings of Criminal Case No.96 of 2008 (State Vs. Jagdish Prasad Bansal), arising out of Case Crime No.73 of 2006, under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468, 471 IPC, P.S. Deoband, District Saharanpur, pending in the court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Deoband, District Saharanpur, on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.

entities.text: Criminal Case No.96 of 2008 (State Vs. Jagdish Prasad Bansal
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Deoband, District Saharanpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. It is contended by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant and opposite party no.2 have entered into compromise and the same has been verified by the learned Court concerned and a report regarding the same has been filed along with the supplementary affidavit which is on the record.
Learned counsel for the applicant further prays that in view of the compromise entered into between the applicants and opposite party no.2, the proceeding of the aforesaid case be quashed.
6. On the other hand, learned AGA for the State has no objection to the above submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant.

7. In view of the fact that applicant and opposite party no.2 have entered into compromised and the said compromise has already been verified by the learned court concerned and a report regarding verification of compromise is already on the record and taking note of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Madhya Pradesh Vs. Laxmi Narayan and others, AIR 2019 SC 1296 and the facts of the matter, it would be in the interest of justice that the impugned proceedings be quashed, in respect of the applicant.

entities.text: State of Madhya Pradesh Vs. Laxmi Narayan and others, AIR 2019 SC 1296
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It was stated that in view of these facts and circumstances,
no useful purpose would be served by keeping the impugned proceedings pending and thus, the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.

8. In view of the aforesaid, the impugned charge-sheets/cognizance-summoning order and entire proceedings of Case Crime No.73 of 2006, under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468, 471 IPC, P.S.
Deoband, District Saharanpur, pending in the court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Deoband, District Saharanpur, against the applicant, is hereby quashed.
9. The application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed.
